FISHING LICENCE · CROATIA

Croatia fishing licence

Visitors need the appropriate freshwater or sea fishing licence. Freshwater licences cover named fishing zones, and the local rights holder adds its own management charges.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Freshwater sport anglers need the licence sold by the fishing-right holder.
  • Sea anglers need the applicable marine recreational or sport licence.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Freshwater day licence: state fee onlyany1 calendar dayEUR 2.65
Freshwater three-day licence: state fee onlyany3 calendar daysEUR 6.64
Freshwater seven-day licence: state fee onlyany7 calendar daysEUR 9.29
Recreational sea day licenceany1 dayEUR 10
Recreational sea three-day licenceany3 daysEUR 25
Recreational sea seven-day licenceany7 daysEUR 45

Extra stamps and permits

  • Freshwater rights-holder management charge
    Required with every freshwater licence; the local holder sets the charge.

Saltwater

Sea licences use a separate system. A recreational sea licence does not allow spearfishing.

Rules visitors should know

  • Use the freshwater licence only in its named zone or an agreed reciprocal zone.
  • An annual freshwater licence requires exam evidence and membership.
  • The freshwater day licence ends at midnight.

How to buy

Buy freshwater licences through the fishing-right holder. Buy recreational sea licences from the ministry's online shop.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Croatia?

Visitors need the appropriate freshwater or sea fishing licence. Freshwater licences cover named fishing zones, and the local rights holder adds its own management charges.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Croatia?

Freshwater day licence: state fee only: EUR 2.65; Freshwater three-day licence: state fee only: EUR 6.64; Freshwater seven-day licence: state fee only: EUR 9.29; Recreational sea day licence: EUR 10 (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Croatia?

Buy freshwater licences through the fishing-right holder. Buy recreational sea licences from the ministry's online shop.
